title: At 18 months the CDC extra-word tally steps up to three
summary: The CDC 18-month communication entry is trying three or more words past mama and dada, and it prints no sample syllables.
body: The 18-month CDC entry raises a tally and stops there: three or more words past mama and dada. No clipped syllable, and no toy or animal, is printed on that entry. A separate entry on the same sheet is obeying one spoken step with no hand motion, such as handing over a toy when told to give it. Obeying is not the tally. The tally is a United States surveillance mark for a group. A slower toddler is not labeled by the entry itself.

sources.title: Milestones by 18 Months
